message: In the 48-volt Lithium Iron Phosphate battery bank (Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4), long-life lithium chemistry) (C3), Manager, the usable autonomy with infiltration has shortfall risk. To check it I used repeat autonomy division reusing the updated daily load calc (E16) because infiltration raised thermal load, forming the autonomy recheck (E21). I found 1.48 days usable from 9.0 kilowatt-hours usable over 6.10 kilowatt-hours per day, according to Zhang and co-workers, 2021. I propose retain 48-volt 240 ampere-hour bank plus ice-bank for night peak shaving. My position: not ready because cloudy refill still needs joint sign-off. In the tilted-roof monocrystalline Photovoltaic array (Photovoltaic (PV), sunlight-to-electricity panels) (C2), Maya, the two-day low-sun refill has deficit problem. To check it I used standard derate sizing reusing the low-sun daily energy calc (E18) because fair-sun sizing underestimates cloudy need, forming the low-sun Photovoltaic sizing (E22). I found 4.06 kilowatts required at 2 Peak Sun Hours (Peak Sun Hours (PSH), equivalent hours at 1000 watts per square metre) with 25 percent losses, according to DIY Eco Homes, 2024. I propose 4 kilowatt tilted south roof array with Maximum Power Point Tracking (Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT), electronics holding panels at peak power) plus ice-bank. My position: not ready because roof support check by you is pending.
